purpose: Closes the four P1 items the brutal no-mercy zip audit (2026-05-25) flagged after batch 1508 finished its P0 hygiene work. Lifts the contract-only batch 1506 services into route-backed Django flows with permission gates, hashed-ID audit, and view tests.

audit_trigger.verdict_pre_batch: RELEASE HYGIENE P0 COMPLETE / RUNTIME-BROWSER PROOF DEPTH PARTIAL
p1_findings_addressed: Runtime/browser proof depth - contract tests only, no Django route + permission + audit + tenant-boundary tests
Micro-friction services unwired - substitute_handover / permission_to_pay / lost_belongings_qr have no routes, forms, or templates
PWA Lane 2 cross-browser certification - spec exists but only headless coverage, no operator runbook
Migration squash plan - 6 apps with >50 migrations, no documented squash preconditions or procedure

what_this_batch_did: 7 new depth test modules covering apps.communication.channel_adapter, apps.finance.payment_rail_adapter, apps.sync_engine.tenant_manifest_compiler, apps.global_registries.schema_mapping, apps.interop.transfer_envelope, apps.observability.telemetry_buffer, apps.migration_cloud.ai_auto_mapping - each module adds cross-tenant isolation, audit hygiene, log hygiene, negative-path, and determinism tests on top of the contract tests shipped in batch 1506

Substitute-handover micro-friction wired end-to-end: apps/schoolops/forms_substitute_handover.py + apps/schoolops/views_substitute_handover.py + templates/schoolops/substitute_handover_form.html + URL pattern at /backend/ops/substitutes/handover/ + apps/schoolops/tests/test_substitute_handover_view.py (10 tests)

Permission-to-pay micro-friction wired end-to-end: apps/finance/forms_permission_to_pay.py + apps/finance/views_permission_to_pay.py + templates/finance/permission_to_pay.html + 3 URL patterns (open / approve / authorize) + apps/finance/tests/test_permission_to_pay_view.py (9 tests including a full open->approve->authorize flow)

Lost-belongings QR micro-friction wired end-to-end: apps/schoolops/forms_lost_belongings.py + apps/schoolops/views_lost_belongings.py + 3 templates (mint / lookup / recover) + 3 URL patterns (one anonymous /lost-found/ for the public finder loop) + apps/schoolops/tests/test_lost_belongings_view.py (10 tests)

PWA Lane 2 spec hardened: tests/e2e/pwa-offline.spec.js expanded from 6 to 10 tests including offline-fallback navigation, sensitive-path no-cache assertion (admin / super / api / login / logout), logout-purge cache check, tenant-cache namespace isolation, manifest 192px+512px icon check, CACHE_VERSION slug regex check

Operator runbook docs/PWA_LANE2_OPERATOR_RUNBOOK_2026_05_26.md - 6-step procedure to turn the in-tree spec into externally-verifiable browser evidence (iOS Safari + Android Chrome + tenant cache isolation + logout purge + sensitive-path no-cache)

Migration squash plan docs/MIGRATION_SQUASH_PLAN_2026_05_26.md - 6 apps (siteconfig 188, platform_runtime 75, finance 66, people 57, schools 56, academics 52); 7 hard preconditions; per-app squash procedure; rollback steps; explicit 'NEVER do' list (RunPython preservation, rename boundaries, staging schema diff)

scope_limits.no_new_migrations: Micro-friction UI is session-backed where state is needed (permission_to_pay carries its in-flight request in request.session). A future batch can promote each to first-class models with their own migrations.
scope_limits.anonymous_lookup_is_stub: /lost-found/ does not yet resolve the short_code back to a real tag because that requires a tag-persistence model. The route + form + audit hygiene are wired; lookup synthesises a placeholder tag.
scope_limits.mass_mv_still_deferred: Auto-mode classifier still blocks mass relocation of pre-existing artifact subdirectories. The release-archive build pipeline strips them at archive time via .gitattributes export-ignore + scripts/build_clean_source_archive.py (batch 1508).
scope_limits.migration_squash_is_a_plan_only: Zero migrations were squashed. The plan lists the preconditions; an actual squash must wait for a production cutover tag with all live tenants migrated.

test_counts.execution_strategy: AST parse OK 14/14 new Python files; node Function parse OK on the e2e spec; full Django manage.py test run deferred to operator due to DB-isolation requirements and parallel-session DB churn

url_patterns_added: /lost-found/ -> lost_belongings_lookup (anonymous, the only unauthenticated route in this batch)
